'''Darth Synn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His descendant [[Synnoran (Lord)|Synnoran]] would become a Sith Lord as well during the [[Galactic War]].
